results.title: Semantics of the power template
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For all natural numbers $P,Q,R$: with $0^0=1$. Consequently, in any natural construction in hierarchical mode, a power call whose argument polynomials take natural values at every natural point and whose block is private (pairwise disjoint from the other blocks and occurring in no other atom or argument) may be replaced by the relation $g_P=g_Q^{\,g_R}$ of its argument values.
